 Jose Mourinho says Real Madrid will not change plan for Lamine Yamal before El Clasico 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article According to Goal.com, Jose Mourinho says Real Madrid will not change their tactical approach to counter Barcelona winger Lamine Yamal , and he has played down the relevance of recent thrashings before Sunday's Liga trip to Camp Nou.
 Madrid head to Barcelona on a high after 4-1 wins over Sevilla and RB Leipzig. Mourinho has stressed that El Clasico is different and that previous results do not grant an edge.
 OneFootball Videos
 Yamal's emergence is a major subplot, yet Mourinho maintains Madrid will stick to their principles. He said great players merit respect, but abandoning plans or structures for one opponent would mean losing their essence.
 Madrid have scored eight across their last two matches in domestic and European competition. Even with that momentum, Mourinho wants absolute focus and no complacency as the pressure and atmosphere can reset the contest.
 Drawing on his experience, he described Clasicos and derbies as matches where what came before carries little weight. He also noted that Real Madrid versus Barcelona often arrives at least twice a season and commands a unique global audience.
 The showdown in Catalonia could shape the Liga picture for the weeks ahead. Both heavyweights will see any positive result as a potential swing in momentum.
